config.claim: Development-only TF-IDF/SVD dense + BPMN graph Stage 3 baseline. word + char n-gram TF-IDF, fixed-seed truncated SVD to a fixed dimension, cosine similarity, plus canonical BPMN sequence-flow reachability. Honest naming: TF-IDF/SVD dense baseline, NOT a pretrained transformer embedding. Fitted ONLY on unlabeled rule texts and process labels (no Gold/decisions).

svd.note: fixed seed + fixed dim; deterministic numpy full-SVD then truncation

method.similarity: cosine in the dense space, clipped to [0,1]
method.fit_corpus: unlabeled rule_text (all 9 distinct rules) + all process action/actor labels of the 7 GDPR7 models; no Gold, no decisions, no parameters chosen on the 58 items
method.matching_formula: matching_score = max(avg best rule-action cosine, avg best rule-actor cosine)
method.violation_semantics: mapping mirrors Sun Definitions 5-7 structure with the arm's similarity; mappings do NOT depend on gamma/theta, so gamma/theta sensitivity is a legitimate score-cutoff re-derivation
method.empty_semantics: empty text -> zero vector -> cosine 0.0, no match, never silently compliant

thresholds.note: pre-registered cosine cutoffs; fixed sweeps reported separately, primary values never selected from Gold

inputs.note: runner reads ONLY the inference pack; no decision/candidate/evidence fields

evaluator.note: same common evaluator and same 58 item IDs as Winter/Sun
